- Interested in Bill Bryson’s *A Short History of Nearly Everything*, including its broad, accessible survey of science.
- Previous suggestions included Dawkins, Sagan, Mukherjee, Wallace-Wells, Jared Diamond, Elizabeth Kolbert, Neil MacGregor, Peter Frankopan, Mark Kurlansky, Carol Dweck, Stephen Covey, Csikszentmihalyi, Gretchen Rubin, and Cal Newport. - Improving Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator skills; already watches LinkedIn Learning and has explored Udemy, Skillshare, Coursera, Pluralsight, Adobe tutorials, Phlearn, Tutvid, Creative Bloq, YouTube, and design communities.

Spanish:
